people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”
translations.bsb: On that same day, Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well they had dug. “We have found water!” they told him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
translations.asv: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
